kurz: Below boiling point, proteins cook gently and evenly. Bubbling water makes them tough and tears them apart.
bild_im_kopf: Like a warm bath instead of a jacuzzi.
was_passiert: Water between about 70 and 85 °C cooks eggs and fish evenly without overcooking the edges. A rolling boil moves the pieces around, tears delicate protein and squeezes out fish.
warum_wichtig: Poached eggs, salmon, chicken breast and boiled beef turn out juicy when the water only shivers and does not boil.
faustregeln: Use fresh eggs for poached eggs.
